status.label: Normal
status.description: Blood sugar levels are within the normal range.
status.advice: Maintain a balanced diet and regular exercise to keep your blood sugar stable.

status.label: Impaired Fasting
status.description: Blood sugar levels are elevated after fasting.
status.advice: Consider lifestyle changes such as a healthier diet, regular physical activity, and monitoring your blood sugar levels.

status.label: Impaired Glucose Tolerance
status.description: Blood sugar levels are elevated after meals.
status.advice: Implement dietary changes, increase physical activity, and consult a healthcare professional for a personalized plan.

status.label: Diabetes
status.advice: Seek medical advice for a comprehensive management plan, including medication, diet, and exercise.
